descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Hacksaw Studios is a company that builds online games. Our games can be played both in social gaming and real money modes. We have a wide distribution and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
 We are currently looking to expand our team with a Quality Assurance Specialist .
 We offer a nice office in Bucharest and transparent remuneration (the salary range for this role will be shared with you via email/message prior to the first interview stage), and an opportunity to work with other experienced colleagues and the chance to take part in building a new team.
 Please note that we are working full time in the office - we believe that in-person collaboration helps us build a stronger team .
 We also offer:
23 days of paid holiday / year
A monthly budget on Benefit Edenred (specific budget details will be provided along with the salary range before the interview).
 Our QA team is closely working with the Development team to make sure our games are of the highest quality. This is a fast paced and constantly changing environment, so the ideal candidate is able to work under pressure, within tight deadlines and can easily adapt to rapid changes in the workflow.
 Your tasks will include
Testing games and game related features (such as user interface, usability, functionality, platform integration) on multiple platforms and operating systems;
Creating, maintaining, improving and following through on test plans, including writing and executing test cases;
Bug and defect handling, analyze deviations between the defined and the actual functional behavior and reporting bugs; additionally, testing the fixes and making sure no regression is introduced;
Sanity checks and functionality tests on existing product portfolios, as the games and platform receive periodical updates;
Working on multiple projects and tasks simultaneously;
Communicating and working in close collaboration with the Development, Account Management and Compliance departments;
Creating, maintaining and improving internal processes according to the needs of the team and in accordance with the requirements communicated by other departments;
Creating, maintaining and handling internal documents required by other departments or clients;
 The ideal candidate needs:
Ability to understand technical specifications and strong analytical skills
Attention to details
Test case writing / checking experience
Ability to achieve performance with tight deadlines and strict planning
Ability to work independently or in small teams
Excellent English (written and spoken) skills
Passion for testing and customer service
Knowledge of testing processes, procedures and methodology
Experience in defining, documenting, maintaining and writing test cases
Previous experience in a similar job will be considered a plus
Ability to work on multiple projects in various stages of development simultaneously
 By applying for this position, you consent to the collection and processing of your information for recruitment purposes.
